title: 480 TypeScript refactor trajectories (claude-code)
description: Self-generated agent logs from a production refactoring assistant: 480 sessions, each with enter/exit spans, tool-call distribution, and a final test result. Fully redaction-scanned.

sample.summary: Median session: 62 events, 11 tool calls, 3 verification runs. Event mix: 41% tool_call, 28% llm_call, 19% turn enter/exit, 12% verification.

records.name: turn-1
records.detail: Extract the session-rotation check that's copy-pasted between src/auth/session.ts and src/auth/session-store.ts into one shared helper — the two copies have drifted and I don't trust them anymore. Keep the auth suite green while you do it.

records.name: claude-sonnet-5
records.detail: I'll read both copies first to see how they drifted, then extract one helper into src/auth/rotation.ts and point both call sites at it without changing refreshSession()'s public signature.

records.name: read_file
records.detail: src/auth/session.ts → L118: if (now - issuedAt > ROTATION_WINDOW_MS && !session.rotating) { return rotateSession(session) }

records.name: read_file
records.detail: src/auth/session-store.ts → L74: same check but with >= — the store rotates exactly at the window boundary, the session module does not.

records.name: claude-sonnet-5
records.detail: Found the drift: > vs >= at the window boundary. Production traffic already rotates at the boundary through the store path, so I'll standardize the shared helper on >= and flag the behavior change.

records.name: claude-sonnet-5
records.detail: That failing test pins the old > behavior. Since >= is the intended unified rule, I'm updating the boundary test to expect rotation at exactly ROTATION_WINDOW_MS and adding a regression test that both call sites share shouldRotate().

records.detail: src/auth/session.test.ts (+12/-7): boundary case now expects rotation at exactly ROTATION_WINDOW_MS; new test imports shouldRotate and asserts both call sites delegate to it.
